title: Research Solutions Announces Agreement With Fortune 500 Biopharma Company Valued At $1 Million
summary: Research Solutions' largest deal in company history with fortune 500 biopharma company supports enterprise demand for AI access to scientific literature.
body_markdown:
*Largest Deal In Company History Further Supports Accelerating Enterprise Demand For AI Access To Scientific Literature*


HENDERSON, Nev., Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --[Research Solutions, Inc.](https://www.researchsolutions.com/) (NASDAQ: RSSS), a leading provider of SaaS and AI-powered scientific research tools, announces the largest deal in company history: an enterprise Scite agreement valued at $1 million with a Fortune 500 biopharmaceutical company. The agreement expands the customer's longstanding Article Galaxy relationship with a full enterprise deployment of Scite across all of its research groups, giving both its researchers and its internal tools access to Scite's Smart Citations and scientific literature search.


Built For How Large Pharma Deploys AI


Large R&D organizations are building new systems for evidence-based literature search, mechanism-of-action research, patent landscaping, and pharmacovigilance. Those systems are only as reliable as the sources they can read and cite. General-purpose models have limited coverage of scholarly content, can hallucinate citations, and cannot tell a supported finding from a contested one. Scite addresses each of these at the infrastructure level.


"Every large R&D organization we talk to is rebuilding their search and discovery tools, and every one of them has the same problem: their AI agents need trusted access to the scientific literature," said Roy W. Olivier, President and Chief Executive Officer of Research Solutions. "This agreement is the largest in our history, and it is not a one-off. It reflects demand we are seeing across our pipeline from companies that need to ground their systems in real evidence."


The agreement followed a months-long enterprise evaluation, which included live demonstrations, a technical trial, and reviews by procurement, legal, information security, technical architecture, and the customer's AI governance function, culminating in executive approval. The agreement covers an enterprise rollout of the Scite platform and full Scite API access with additional Scite datasets. These products allow the organization's internal tools to search and evaluate peer-reviewed literature, cite the evidence behind an answer, check the veracity of claims, and retrieve licensed full text through existing entitlements within the workflows the organization already runs.


**About Research Solutions**


Research Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSSS) is a holding Company providing software and AI solutions for enterprise R&D teams and academic institutions. Through its Scite and Article Galaxy products, the Company combines proprietary data, integrated workflows, and access infrastructure to give modern researchers and their AI systems the tools to find, trust, and act on scientific research faster.


For more information about Research Solutions, visit:[www.researchsolutions.com](https://www.researchsolutions.com/) |[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/research-solutions) |[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ResearchSolu) |[X](https://twitter.com/ResearchSolu)


**About Scite**


Scite is an AI-powered research platform that helps researchers discover and evaluate scientific literature using Smart Citations - a technology that analyzes the full text of citing articles to show whether findings have been supported, mentioned, or contrasted by subsequent research. Scite is used by millions of researchers and is available as a web platform, browser extension, and Zotero plugin. For more information, visit[https://www.scite.ai](https://www.scite.ai/) . Scite is a product of Research Solutions (NASDAQ: RSSS).


About Article Galaxy


Article Galaxy is a scientific literature access platform that gives R&D teams and academic institutions on-demand access to 80M+ full-text, peer-reviewed journal articles. Article Galaxy routes every request through the most cost-effective, compliant path, whether via an existing subscription, open access, or a one-time purchase, with article-level reuse rights built into each transaction. Researchers can order full text directly from PubMed, Google Scholar, and 70+ other discovery environments. For more information, visit[https://www.articlegalaxy.com/](https://www.articlegalaxy.com/) . Article Galaxy is a product of Research Solutions (NASDAQ: RSSS).
